reason: There is indeed no null check at services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/TokenManager.java:1052-1054, but the same patch registers the SPI (services/src/main/resources/META-INF/services/org.keycloak.provider.Spi:28) and a built-in factory with id "default" (DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.java:94-96, service file line 20). DefaultKeycloakSessionFactory.java:301-308 resolves a sole or "default"-id factory as the default provider, so getProvider cannot return null unless an operator explicitly disables the built-in provider.
